Global Operations

Updated April 17, 2026

Global Operations and Cross-Border Platform

Workglobal is a borderless digital recruitment ecosystem. While our parent company is headquartered in the United Kingdom, we operate a global marketplace with significant operational hubs and physical offices located across Asia and within major international transportation hubs worldwide.

By using the Platform, you acknowledge that your data, communications, and employment matches may cross international borders. We comply with international data protection frameworks, but it is your sole responsibility to ensure that your use of the Platform complies with your local laws, regulations, and employment standards.

Eligibility and Account Registration

Updated April 17, 2026

Eligibility and Account Registration

To access the core features of Workglobal, you must register for an account as either a "Jobseeker" or an "Employer."

Age Requirement: You must be at least eighteen (18) years of age to use this Platform. By creating an account, you legally warrant that you meet this age requirement.

Account Accuracy: You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during the registration process. Employers must provide verifiable business details. Jobseekers must provide authentic representations of their skills, education, and work history.

Account Security: You are strictly responsible for safeguarding your password and any other credentials used to access your account.

Ecosystem Affiliates and Strategic Partners

Updated April 17, 2026

Ecosystem Affiliates and Strategic Partners

Workglobal operates within a wider corporate ecosystem. To provide a comprehensive professional experience, we partner with and share information alongside our parent company, Resource Pool Group Ltd, its subsidiaries, and trusted strategic partners.

Corporate Subsidiaries: We may connect you with our subsidiaries, such as Hiredesk.services or Bilocation.

Partner Services: Any engagement with our subsidiaries or third-party strategic partners is strictly subject to their respective terms of service and separate agreements.

No Immigration or Legal Advice

Updated April 17, 2026

No Immigration or Legal Advice

Workglobal connects global talent with international opportunities; however, we are not a law firm, an immigration agency, or a visa consultancy.

No Visa Sponsorship Facilitation: Matching with an international employer on the Platform does not guarantee visa sponsorship, work authorisation, or immigration success. Workglobal is entirely removed from the legal immigration process.

Referral to Partners: Workglobal does not provide immigration advice. Should an international hire require cross border legal compliance, visa sponsorship, or Employer of Record services, we will only refer users to our corporate subsidiaries.

User Responsibility: It is the sole responsibility of the Employer and the Jobseeker to ensure that any employment arrangement complies with all relevant local, national, and international labor and immigration laws. Workglobal disclaims all liability for any legal, financial, or immigration related issues arising from a match made on the Platform.

User Conduct and Acceptable Use

Updated April 17, 2026

User Conduct and Acceptable Use

Workglobal maintains a professional, equitable, and highly efficient ecosystem. You agree NOT to engage in any of the following prohibited activities:

The Anti-Ghosting Protocol: Workglobal is built on rapid communication. If an Employer or Jobseeker repeatedly matches and initiates chats but fails to respond for extended periods ("ghosting"), Workglobal reserves the right to algorithmically penalize the user’s profile visibility or suspend the account.

Fraud and Misrepresentation: Creating fake profiles, posting fraudulent job listings, misrepresenting your qualifications, or impersonating another person or business entity is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account termination.

Data Scraping: You may not use automated scripts, bots, spiders, or scrapers to extract data, candidate profiles, or job listings from the Platform.

Discrimination and Harassment: You may not use the Platform's messaging system to harass, abuse, or discriminate against any user based on race, gender, religion, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation.

Subscriptions, Fees, and Payments

Updated April 17, 2026

Subscriptions, Fees, and Payments

Workglobal offers both free and premium subscription tiers for users.

Billing and Renewal: Premium subscriptions are billed on a recurring basis depending on your selected plan. By providing payment information, you authorize Workglobal (via our third-party payment processors) to charge the applicable fees automatically.

No Refunds: All subscription fees, job posting credits, and in-app purchases are non-refundable. If you cancel your subscription, you will retain access to the premium features until the end of your current billing cycle.
